headline: Turkey's Capital Markets to Rebound After Fund Probe Liquidation Payouts
summary: Vice President Cevdet Yilmaz announced that fund probe liquidation payouts will reach $3.93 billion with 98% of investors paid and no Treasury funds utilized.
why: Turkey's capital markets and regulatory authorities oversee investor protections and financial system stability.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Orderly liquidation payouts restore investor confidence following market regulatory investigations.
